name: Hugo 75
desc: Bright, effervescent cocktail pairing botanical indigo gin with delicate elderflower and dry bubbly.
recipe: 1.5 oz Empress 1908 Indigo Gin, 0.75 oz Elderflower Liqueur, 0.75 oz Fresh Lime Juice, 0.5 oz Simple Syrup, 4-5 Mint Leaves, Top with Dry Sparkling Wine
ingredients: Empress 1908 Indigo Gin, Elderflower Liqueur, Fresh Lime Juice, Simple Syrup, Fresh Mint, Sparkling Wine

name: Apple Cider Mule
desc: Crisp autumn orchard mule with green apple vodka, sweet spiced cider, and ginger heat.
recipe: 2 oz Smirnoff Green Apple Vodka, 2 oz Sweet Apple Cider, 0.5 oz Fresh Lime Juice, 3-4 oz Ginger Beer
ingredients: Smirnoff Green Apple Vodka, Apple Cider, Fresh Lime Juice, Ginger Beer

name: Pumpkin Spice Espresso Martini
desc: Rich dessert martini balancing freshly pulled espresso with pumpkin liqueur and warm baking spice.
recipe: 1.5 oz Pumpkin Vodka, 1 oz Kahlúa Coffee Liqueur, 1 oz Fresh Espresso, Dash Pumpkin Pie Spice
ingredients: Pumpkin Vodka, Kahlúa, Fresh Espresso, Pumpkin Spice

name: Maple Old Fashioned
desc: Smooth, spirit-forward blend of straight bourbon and pure maple syrup crowned with bright citrus oil.
recipe: 2 oz Bourbon Whiskey, 0.25 oz Pure Maple Syrup, 2-3 Dashes Aromatic Bitters
ingredients: Bourbon Whiskey, Pure Maple Syrup, Angostura Aromatic Bitters
glass: Rocks Glass with Large Ice Cube

name: Cinnamon White Russian
desc: Decadent, creamy nightcap spiked with house-made cinnamon syrup and dark coffee liqueur.
recipe: 2 oz Vodka, 1 oz Coffee Liqueur, 0.5 oz House Cinnamon Syrup, Heavy Cream float
ingredients: Vodka, Coffee Liqueur, Cinnamon Simple Syrup, Heavy Cream

name: Autumn Hugo Spritz
desc: Fall iteration of the alpine spritz combining tart cranberry, elderflower, Prosecco, and garden mint.
recipe: 1.5 oz Elderflower Liqueur, 1.5 oz Tart Cranberry Juice, 3 oz Prosecco, 1 oz Sparkling Water, Squeeze of Fresh Lime
ingredients: Elderflower Liqueur, Cranberry Juice, Prosecco, Sparkling Water, Fresh Mint, Lime Juice

name: Long Island Apple Iced Tea
desc: Crisp five-spirit highball built with crisp apple cider and lemon-lime effervescence. Limit 2 per visit.
recipe: 0.5 oz Apple Vodka, 0.5 oz Triple Sec, 0.5 oz Gin, 0.5 oz White Rum, 0.5 oz Blanco Tequila, 2 oz Apple Cider, Splash of Starry
ingredients: Apple Vodka, Triple Sec, Gin, White Rum, Tequila, Apple Cider, Starry Soda
